verses.original: שִׁלְחוּ־ כַ֥ר מֹשֵֽׁל־ אֶ֖רֶץ מִסֶּ֣לַע מִדְבָּ֑רָה אֶל־ הַ֖ר בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šil·ḥū- ḵar mō·šêl- ’e·reṣ mis·se·la‘ miḏ·bā·rāh ’el- har baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Send the tribute lambs to the ruler of the land from Sela in the desert to the mount of Daughter Zion

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה כְעוֹף־ נוֹדֵ֖ד קֵ֣ן מְשֻׁלָּ֑ח תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מַעְבָּרֹ֖ת לְאַרְנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵə·‘ō·wp̄- nō·w·ḏêḏ qên mə·šul·lāḥ tih·ye·nāh bə·nō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ ma‘·bā·rōṯ lə·’ar·nō·wn
verses.literal: Like fluttering birds . . . pushed out of the nest so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon

verses.original: הָבִיאוּ עֵצָה֙ עֲשׂ֣וּ פְלִילָ֔ה שִׁ֧יתִי כַלַּ֛יִל צִלֵּ֖ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ צָהֳרָ֑יִם סַתְּרִי֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים נֹדֵ֖ד אַל־ תְּגַלִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hå̄·ḇī·ʾū ‘ê·ṣāh ‘ă·śū p̄ə·lî·lāh šî·ṯî ḵal·la·yil ṣil·lêḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ ṣā·ho·rā·yim sat·tə·rî nid·dā·ḥîm nō·ḏêḏ ’al- tə·ḡal·lî
verses.literal: Give us counsel render a decision . . . Shelter us at noonday with shade . . . as dark as night Hide the refugees do not betray the one who flees

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ בָךְ֙ נִדָּחַ֔י מוֹאָ֛ב הֱוִי־ סֵ֥תֶר לָ֖מוֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹדֵ֑ד כִּֽי־ אָפֵ֤ס הַמֵּץ֙ כָּ֣לָה שֹׁ֔ד תַּ֥מּוּ רֹמֵ֖ס מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡū·rū ḇāḵ nid·dā·ḥay mō·w·’āḇ hĕ·wî- sê·ṯer lā·mōw mip·pə·nê šō·w·ḏêḏ kî- ’ā·p̄ês ham·mêṣ kā·lāh šōḏ tam·mū rō·mês min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Let my fugitives stay with you be a refuge for Moab from the destroyer When the oppressor has gone destruction has ceased and the oppressors have vanished from the land

verses.original: וְהוּכַ֤ן בַּחֶ֙סֶד֙ כִּסֵּ֔א וְיָשַׁ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל דָּוִ֑ד שֹׁפֵ֛ט וְדֹרֵ֥שׁ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּמְהִ֥ר צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū·ḵan ba·ḥe·seḏ kis·sê wə·yā·šaḇ ‘ā·lāw be·’ĕ·meṯ bə·’ō·hel dā·wiḏ šō·p̄êṭ wə·ḏō·rêš miš·pāṭ ū·mə·hir ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: in loving devotion a throne will be established in the tent of David A judge seeking justice and hastening righteousness will sit on it in faithfulness

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־ מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּ֣א מְאֹ֑ד גַּאֲוָת֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ לֹא־ כֵ֥ן בַּדָּֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·nū ḡə·’ō·wn- mō·w·’āḇ gê mə·’ōḏ ga·’ă·wā·ṯōw ū·ḡə·’ō·w·nōw wə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw lō- ḵên bad·dāw
verses.literal: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity his exceeding pride and conceit his overflowing arrogance But his boasting is empty . . .

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יְיֵלִ֥יל מוֹאָ֛ב לְמוֹאָ֖ב כֻּלֹּ֣ה יְיֵלִ֑יל לַאֲשִׁישֵׁ֧י קִיר־ חֲרֶ֛שֶׂת תֶּהְגּ֖וּ אַךְ־ נְכָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yə·yê·lîl mō·w·’āḇ lə·mō·w·’āḇ kul·lōh yə·yê·lîl la·’ă·šî·šê qîr- ḥă·re·śeṯ teh·gū ’aḵ- nə·ḵā·’îm
verses.literal: Therefore let Moab wail let them wail together for Moab Moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you who are utterly stricken

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׁדְמוֹת֩ חֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן אֻמְלָ֜ל גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י גוֹיִם֙ הָלְמ֣וּ שְׂרוּקֶּ֔יהָ עַד־ יַעְזֵ֥ר נָגָ֖עוּ תָּ֣עוּ מִדְבָּ֑ר שְׁלֻ֣חוֹתֶ֔יהָ נִטְּשׁ֖וּ עָ֥בְרוּ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî šaḏ·mō·wṯ ḥeš·bō·wn ’um·lāl ge·p̄en śiḇ·māh ba·‘ă·lê ḡō·w·yim hā·lə·mū śə·rūq·qe·hā ‘aḏ- ya‘·zêr nā·ḡā·‘ū tā·‘ū miḏ·bār šə·lu·ḥō·w·ṯe·hā niṭ·ṭə·šū ‘ā·ḇə·rū yām
verses.literal: For the fields of Heshbon have withered along with the grapevines of Sibmah The rulers of the nations have trampled its choicest vines which had reached as far as Jazer and spread toward the desert Their shoots had spread out and passed over the sea

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּבְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֙וֶךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔י חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה כִּ֧י עַל־ קֵיצֵ֛ךְ וְעַל־ קְצִירֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד נָפָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’eḇ·keh biḇ·ḵî ya‘·zêr ge·p̄en śiḇ·māh ’ă·ray·yā·weḵ dim·‘ā·ṯî ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’el·‘ā·lêh kî ‘al- qê·ṣêḵ wə·‘al- qə·ṣî·rêḵ hê·ḏāḏ nā·p̄āl
verses.literal: So . . . I weep . . . with Jazer for the vines of Sibmah I drench Heshbon and Elealeh . . . with my tears Triumphant shouts have fallen silent over your summer fruit . . . and your harvest

verses.original: וְנֶאֱסַ֨ף שִׂמְחָ֤ה וָגִיל֙ מִן־ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וּבַכְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא־ יְרֻנָּ֖ן לֹ֣א יְרֹעָ֑ע יַ֗יִן בַּיְקָבִ֛ים לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ הַדֹּרֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄ śim·ḥāh wā·ḡîl min- hak·kar·mel ū·ḇak·kə·rā·mîm lō- yə·run·nān lō yə·rō·‘ā‘ ya·yin bay·qā·ḇîm lō- yiḏ·rōḵ had·dō·rêḵ hê·ḏāḏ hiš·bat·tî
verses.literal: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard no one sings or shouts in the vineyards No one tramples . . . the grapes in the winepresses . . . I have put an end to the cheering

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ מֵעַ֣י לְמוֹאָ֔ב כַּכִּנּ֖וֹר יֶֽהֱמ֑וּ וְקִרְבִּ֖י לְקִ֥יר חָֽרֶשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên mê·‘ay lə·mō·w·’āḇ kak·kin·nō·wr ye·hĕ·mū wə·qir·bî lə·qîr ḥā·reś
verses.literal: Therefore . . . my heart laments for Moab like a harp my inmost being for Kir-heres

verses.original: וְהָיָ֧ה כִֽי־ נִרְאָ֛ה כִּֽי־ נִלְאָ֥ה מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־ הַבָּמָ֑ה וּבָ֧א אֶל־ מִקְדָּשׁ֛וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יוּכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵî- nir·’āh kî- nil·’āh mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- hab·bā·māh ū·ḇā ’el- miq·dā·šōw lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl wə·lō yū·ḵāl
verses.literal: When Moab appears on the high place when he wearies himself and enters . . . his sanctuary to pray it will do him no good

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מוֹאָ֖ב מֵאָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·w·’āḇ mê·’āz
verses.literal: This is the message that the LORD spoke earlier concerning Moab

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בְּשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ כִּשְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְנִקְלָה֙ כְּב֣וֹד מוֹאָ֔ב בְּכֹ֖ל הֶהָמ֣וֹן הָרָ֑ב וּשְׁאָ֥ר מְעַ֛ט מִזְעָ֖ר ל֥וֹא כַבִּֽיר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh dib·ber Yah·weh lê·mōr bə·šā·lōš šā·nîm kiš·nê śā·ḵîr wə·niq·lāh kə·ḇō·wḏ mō·w·’āḇ bə·ḵōl he·hā·mō·wn hā·rāḇ ū·šə·’ār mə·‘aṭ miz·‘ār lō·w ḵab·bîr
verses.literal: And now the LORD . . . says In three years as a hired worker counts the years Moab’s splendor will become an object of contempt with all her many people And those who are left will be few . . . and feeble . . .
